stories.previousTitle: A duplicate registration is refused and refunded
stories.title: A duplicate registration waits for its deadline and is returned
stories.disposition: The early lifecycle-mismatch rejection is refused until the deadline; the duplicate is returned after it, contents less tip to its refund address.

stories.previousTitle: Alice retracts in the recovery window
stories.title: Alice cannot cancel her request before its deadline
stories.disposition: The owner retraction window is gone: until the deadline only a fold spends the request; at the deadline anyone, Alice included, returns it without a signature.

stories.title: Sam returns an expired registration to Alice
stories.disposition: The expiry rejection becomes the return after the deadline; a redirected refund is refused.

stories.previousTitle: Alice parks and revives her retained output
stories.title: Alice parks and revives her retained output
stories.disposition: Retired: there is no owner exit, so there is no parking and no revival. The number is kept; the story is not played.

stories.previousTitle: Parking cannot be swept into a termination
stories.title: A live carrier cannot be swept into a termination
stories.disposition: The parking step is removed: a live carrier cannot be booked for termination (Registry.live_cannot_book); the refused booking is unchanged.

stories.previousTitle: Alice returns with the same token binding
stories.title: Alice returns with the same token binding
stories.disposition: Retired: there is no parked state, so there is no revival. The number is kept; the story is not played.

stories.previousTitle: Conviction becomes permanent through the consuming fold
stories.title: Conviction becomes permanent through the consuming fold
stories.disposition: Unchanged behaviour; the close-authorization and rotation-from evidence kinds leave the environment.

stories.title: Cora convicts the parked output
stories.disposition: Retired: there is no parked state, so there is no conviction of a parked carrier; active conviction is story 12. The number is kept; the story is not played.

stories.previousTitle: A pending termination has only the consuming fold exit
stories.title: A pending termination has only the consuming fold exit
stories.disposition: The retraction control is removed; returning the pending termination is refused because the return applies to registrations only.

stories.previousTitle: Batch inputs, timestamps and independent custody
stories.title: Batch inputs, timestamps and independent custody
stories.disposition: The mixed-custody branch returns its registration after the deadline instead of retracting it.
